header.publisher: CMS Office of the Actuary, National Health Expenditure Projections 2025-2034
lawRefs: CMS National Health Expenditure Projections 2025-2034, Table 1 (per capita NHE; CPI-U)
header.notes: All values are derived from Table 1 of the CMS NHE projections (historical through 2024, projected 2025-2034). nheProjection = year-over-year growth of per capita national health expenditures, computed from the per capita dollar amounts. defaultNominal = compound annual growth of per capita NHE 2024-2034; excessOverCpi = defaultNominal minus the compound annual CPI-U growth in the same table (2.45%). excessStdDev = sample standard deviation of (per capita NHE growth - CPI-U growth) over the historical years 2014-2024 in the same table (11 observations, including the 2020 pandemic spike and 2022 inflation; historical mean excess 2.28%). Per capita NHE measures total spending per person (price and utilisation), not any one premium. sha256 is of the raw source document as downloaded.

flags.excessStdDev: derived from 11 historical observations; not a CMS-published statistic
flags.defaultNominal: projection (CMS actuaries), not an enacted parameter
